universe_and_filters.ours: All NYSE/AMEX stocks; NASDAQ stocks excluded; stocks priced below $5 at the beginning of the holding period excluded
universe_and_filters.reference: excludes stocks priced below $5 and stocks in the smallest NYSE size decile at formation

ours: stock prices (filter: exclude stocks priced below $5)
exchange listing (filter: NYSE/AMEX only, exclude NASDAQ)

signal_formula_words.ours: Each stock's past six-month return over the ranking period (month -5 to month 0)
signal_formula_words.reference: cumulative stock return over months t-5 to t (six-month formation period)

skip_window.reference: none in this paper (formation ends month 0, holding starts month 1). Note: JT 1993 and much later work skip one week or one month; accept either if the LLM states which.

holding_period.ours: 6 months (month 1 to month 6), with overlapping monthly cohorts each given equal weight

rebalance_frequency.ours: monthly (stocks ranked at the end of each month; overlapping portfolios hold the previous six monthly cohorts)
rebalance_frequency.reference: monthly, overlapping cohorts (each month holds the six most recent cohorts with equal weight)

breakpoints.ours: equal-count deciles (ten percent of the sample stocks each) of NYSE/AMEX stocks ranked on past six-month returns

favored_group.ours: P1 (past winners): decile with the highest past six-month returns

disfavored_group.ours: P10 (past losers): decile with the lowest past six-month returns

headline_result.ours: P1-P10 return of 1.11% per month (t-statistic 4.61) over 1965-1989; 1.01% per month (t 4.10) over 1990-1997; 1.09% per month (t 5.65) over 1965-1997
headline_result.reference: winner minus loser average monthly return: 1.11 % per month (1965-1989)
